Alpha Tester MCP

Your agents, our feedback: what already works and what comes next.

Today and the roadmap

    Today

    • MCP server over stdio.
    • Secret key with the manage scope.
    • Seven tools in three tiers: T0 read · T1 note and priority · T2 status and issue.
    • A limit per tier and an audit record per session.
    claude mcp add alpha-tester -- at-mcp --max-tier T2

    The key comes from the dashboard and lives in the client's own configuration, never in the repository.

    Why on the client side

    • The budget is the client's own subscription.
    • Repository credentials stay with them: the pull request is born on the client's machine, with their permissions.
    • Harder issues become possible, with a person in the session.
    • Code stays where the client already works: their agent reaches the repository through GitHub's own MCP, not through the platform.
    • Code never leaves the client's machine or CI.
    • Alpha Tester keeps capture, screening, routing, tracking and the status page.

    No roadmap item is a promise of a date; it is the order.
